en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a studio photograph of a triangular carved stone relief. The relief depicts a stylized running or leaping bull or ox, framed by a border of simple geometric and foliate motifs. The stone looks weathered and broken along two sides, suggesting it is a fragment of a larger medieval or Romanesque sculpture. There is a wide blank margin around the photo and no visible caption or text on the image side.
